name: Imani Ford
life: “I still remember a disconnected call followed by a whole afternoon wondering.” On Thursday, near the approach to Seabright Court, Imani likes to watch the beach traffic thin enough for workers going the other way.
voice: I took the first call and lost the connection. I have never known whether she got somebody back.
appearance: Imani is easy to recognize by close-cropped dark curls and a small notch in the left eyebrow. Usually dressed in a plum-colored cardigan with a comb in a sleeve sewn into the lining, Imani gathers both sleeves neatly before settling in when listening.
personality: Imani listens for the familiar version of a story and then for the one detail that changes it. Friends bring problems here when they want to be heard twice.
agenda: To learn how the interrupted call ended.
family: Wesley Joseph is Imani’s half-sibling. Imani is free to hang up first. Wesley makes the call. Some of their best calls last less than a minute. A change of tone is sometimes all the news either one needs. Asked about *Five missing lunches*, Wesley says, “We used to swap the sweet things. With my new shift I don't know anybody's favorite.”
connections: Fern Lin (second call taker). Restoring both voices to the letter is their first shared task after the interrupted call.

reactions.situation: A supervisor offers thanks to only one call taker
reactions.response: Imani gets both halves of the call into the account before a name goes up.

reactions.situation: An unfamiliar person asks for directions but cannot read the street signs
reactions.response: Imani walks with them as far as the first landmark and points to the next one from there.
